entities.name: Nafiz Gürman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdurrahman Nafiz Gürman was a Turkish military officer of the Ottoman Army and a general of the Turkish Army. He fought in the Caucasus campaign during World War I. He later joined the forces of Atatürk and participated in the Turkish War of Independence. After his retirement in 1949, he was the Turkish Ambassador to South Korea and Pahlavi Iran, until 1959.

entities.summary: Abdurrahman Nafiz Gürman was a Turkish military officer of the Ottoman Army and a general of the Turkish Army. He fought in the Caucasus campaign during World War I. He later joined the forces of Atatürk and participated in the Turkish War of Independence. After his retirement in 1949, he was the Turkish Ambassador to South Korea and Pahlavi Iran, until 1959.
